notes: DEMO DATA (after the QA pass): 120 guests + invitations + RSVPs on the promo event, written with the app's own service semantics (addGuestsBulk / markInvitationShared / markViewed / submitRsvp; E.164 050000xxxx-style fake numbers; independent 256-bit tokens; partySize clamped to seats). Timeline: host designed, signed up and paid on Fri 25 Sep 2026 20:38–20:41 Riyadh (Event/Order/User timestamps backdated from 29 Sep in the local DB); big guest list added 26 Sep 20:05, sent 26–28 Sep (first send 26 Sep 21:40 Riyadh = detailsLockedAt); her pasted short list 28 Sep; أم فهد replied 29 Sep. The 29 demo guests that had never been sent (plus one extra demo SENT guest) were removed and «الجوهرة» (pasted, never sent) marked sent, so every guest on the list has been sent: 120 = 78 accepted + 9 declined + 33 pending. Pre-demo snapshot: capture/db-before-demo.dump; pre-QA-fix snapshot: capture/fix/db-before-qa-fix.dump.

Guest messages on c11: أم فهد's real RSVP message on top, then demo «مبروك يا نورة، الله يسعدكم 🤍» and «ألف مبروك وبالرفاه والبنين» (the product shows only the latest 3; «الله يتمم لكم على خير» and a 4th exist but are not displayed).

أم فهد's RSVP was submitted through the real guest page (then reset once and re-submitted through the UI during the first pass). During the QA pass it was cleared once more only for the 440x956 filled-form still and restored byte-for-byte (same Rsvp row and respondedAt 29 Sep 00:51 UTC); the final state is one real ACCEPTED reply (party 3) plus her door check-in (3 of 3).

MUSIC: the house track is a TikTok embed that cannot load in this offline sandbox. For the guest captures (c10-*, c02c-*) the hidden 1x1 player iframe was replaced by a local stub that speaks the same postMessage protocol, so the app's real pill shows the state a phone shows while the song plays («إيقاف الموسيقى», vinyl icon). No audio. The c04 preview stills were re-shot in the QA pass with the same stub, so they match c10 (pill «تشغيل الموسيقى» on the closed cover, «إيقاف الموسيقى» after opening).

DOOR CAMERA: headless Chromium has no camera; the scanner used Chromium's fake capture device fed with locally generated Y4M clips (idle = blurred warm hall; others = a phone showing a guest's REAL pass screenshot). The QR decode (jsQR in the app), check-in writes and results are real. أم فهد was admitted via the name search («أدخليها»), أم محمد and خالتي منيرة via camera scans, then أم فهد's pass was scanned again → «هذي الدعوة تم استخدامها من قبل». خالتي منيرة's check-in was reset and re-done through the camera to film the slide-in scan sequence (twice: first pass and QA pass).

ATTENDANCE (c13): 48 more check-ins were written with performCheckIn semantics (seat count, PARTIALLY_USED/FULLY_USED, SUCCESS CheckInLog, gateStaffId null). The report only switches on after the event start, so eventDate was temporarily set to ~95 min before capture and then restored to 2026-11-19 17:30 UTC (20:30 Riyadh). Other shots show the real date/countdown.

SEQUENCES: c10-seq-open, c10-seq-scroll, c10-seq-pass, c12-seq-scan — JPEG frames 1170x2532 from CDP Page.startScreencast (q92; scroll q88). Frames arrive only on repaint, so use sequence.json: frames[].t (seconds from first frame, sorted — screencast occasionally delivers out of order) and frames30 (frame to show at each 1/30 s). c12-seq-scan ends with 8 page.screenshot frames (s0000–s0007) because screencast stops delivering frames once the camera stream stops.

PRODUCT BUG FOUND (report to the team): on the send queue (/events/<id>/send) tapping «أرسل عبر واتساب» opens WhatsApp for the NEXT guest. The anchor's onClick (handOff) updates state, React re-renders the same <a> with the next guest's href before the browser follows the link. Observed: tapping أم فهد's card recorded أم فهد as sent but opened wa.me/966500001102 with أم محمد's personal link. File: web/src/components/events/send-queue.tsx.

Dev-only UI: OTP code on screen (c05c-otp — use c05c-otp-clean) and the mock payment block (c05d — leave out). Seed prices appear in several shots (listed per file; -noprice variants exist for C1, C5, C8b). URLs show localhost:3000.

The landing page and the activate comparison table still carry older door copy («كل مسحة تحتسب فرداً… «مستخدمة بالكامل»») that differs from the scanner, which asks «كم شخص دخل؟» and says «هذي الدعوة تم استخدامها من قبل» (visible in c01-landing-full / c05-activate-full).

Guest link opens in the real (not preview) mode: markViewed moved أم فهد to VIEWED, and the pass carries her real QR (qrToken). The pass prints «عدد الأشخاص: 3» (her allowance) in Latin digits, as the product does.
NOT CAPTURED: see «STILL NOT POSSIBLE HERE» below.
Browser UI: the details form uses the browser's native radio/checkbox styling (blue accent) — that is the product as rendered in Chrome/Android.

QA-FIX PASS — what changed in the local DB (all local, reversible, nothing remote touched): (1) Event.createdAt, EventCouple.createdAt, Order.createdAt/paidAt and the host User.createdAt/phoneVerifiedAt moved back 3 d 7 h to 25 Sep; (2) unsent demo guests removed as above; (3) Event.groomMotherAr/brideMotherAr = «أم عبدالله»/«أم سعد» (no-break space); (4) door check-ins were snapshotted (fix/checkinlog.csv, fix/checkin-guests.csv), removed for the pre-wedding re-shoots, restored exactly, then خالتي منيرة's check-in was reset once more and re-done through the real camera scan (c12-seq-scan); (5) أم فهد's reply was cleared for the 440x956 filled-form take and restored from fix/omfahad-rsvp.csv (same row, same respondedAt); (6) the 56 non-live legacy seed designs were set to HIDDEN for the gallery / details-form takes and set back to PUBLISHED (fix/hidden-themes.txt); (7) a throwaway empty copy of the event (id capfixevent…) was created for the paste-a-list takes and deleted again with its 9 pasted guests; (8) Event/EventCouple English names blanked only while rendering c14b, then restored; (9) eventDate moved to ~95 min before capture for c13 and restored to 2026-11-19 17:30 UTC; detailsLockedAt nulled only while re-shooting c05e and restored.

EDITED-AT-CAPTURE VARIANTS (clearly named; the unedited real screens are kept beside them): *-noprice.png hide every «… ر.س» figure with visibility:hidden (layout untouched); c05c-otp-clean.png removes the dev-only mock-SMS line with display:none (production never renders it); c13-attendance-notime.png removes only the «آخر تحديث … بتوقيت الرياض» line (it prints the capture machine's clock, ~5 AM Riyadh). Crops: c10-guest-21-pass-card-crop.png, c10-guest-02-opened-name-crop.png (pixel crops, no scaling).

TALL PAGES: every -full.png taller than 16,000 px is also provided as -full-pN.png parts (≤16,000 px, cut at empty rows). c06-dashboard-full.png (35,229 px) and c13-attendance-full.png (44,619 px) exceeded Chromium's 32,767 px canvas limit and now exist only as parts (-p1..-p3); the whole images were moved to capture/fix/superseded/.

PRODUCT ISSUES TO REPORT (seen while capturing; not fixable from the capture side): (a) web/src/app/[locale]/events/[eventId]/page.tsx:108 computes «بانتظار الرد» as rows.length − accepted − declined, so unsent guests count as pending under a card headed «على X دعوة مرسلة» (numbers stop adding up whenever some guests are unsent; hidden in the captures by the data fix, not by code); (b) guest pass at 390x844 and 440x956: square card over the page's own bride art (seam, two brides), footer line over the flowers, tiny «عدد الأشخاص»; (c) opened card: «يسعدنا حضوركم ومشاركتنا هذه الفرحة» touches the flower sprigs; (d) the RSVP form box scrolls/clips at ≤430x932 once «عدد الأشخاص» appears; (e) «المرافقون: 3» shows party size (incl. the guest) and mixes Latin with Arabic-Indic digits; (f) event name «حفل زفاف فيصل و نورة» has a detached «و» (web/src/lib/events/event-name.ts); (g) link-preview image is English-first (previewNames() prefers English names; eyebrow and date always en-US); (h) a ~70 ms blank frame when the opened envelope mounts, and a one-frame black camera box when the scanner stops; (i) send-queue WhatsApp button opens the NEXT guest's chat (see earlier note); (j) a mother's name like «أم عبدالله» wraps between «أم» and the name unless typed with a no-break space.

STILL NOT POSSIBLE HERE: Apple/Google Wallet button (no signing keys locally, never renders), the real Moyasar card form (dev uses the mock), a WhatsApp chat screen (C9 is a graphic), a server clock reading an evening time on the attendance report (the dev server runs on the machine clock; handled with c13-attendance-notime.png), and the production design catalogue (local copies of the live families were used).
